metadata.description: Normalized cycle progress timing windows [start_fraction, end_fraction] for 5 cultivation stages across focus crops.
metadata.note: Fraction t in [0.0, 1.0] representing normalized cycle progress (Days After Sowing / Total Cycle Days).
metadata.citation_status: All stage windows are marked 'assumption' with widened ranges; no institute homepage citations.

land_preparation.notes: Initial 1st/2nd plowing, bund plastering, and puddling prior to seeding.

fertilizer_basal.notes: Basal fertilizer incorporated during final leveling or within first 14 DAS.

crop_care.notes: Early weed control, 1st & 2nd top dressings, water management through reproductive phase.

harvest.notes: Combine harvesting, threshing, drying, and field transport.

land_preparation.notes: Plowing, harrowing, and ridge/furrow formation prior to planting.

planting.notes: Direct seed dibbling at 2 seeds per hill, thinning, and gap filling.

fertilizer_basal.notes: Basal fertilizer applied in planting furrows at sowing.

crop_care.notes: Critical weed-free period and split top-dressings up to tasseling/silking.

harvest.notes: Cob picking, de-husking, sun drying, and mechanical shelling.

land_preparation.notes: Deep plowing, bed preparation, and basal organic manure incorporation.

planting.notes: Transplanting nursery seedlings into field with establishment watering.

fertilizer_basal.notes: Basal fertilizer applied before or at transplanting.

crop_care.notes: Staking, split top dressings, and spray rounds.

harvest.notes: Multiple staggered pickings commencing from 70 DAS through 110 DAS.

land_preparation.notes: Primary tillage, ridge and furrow formation, nursery beds.

fertilizer_basal.notes: Basal fertilizer incorporated into ridges before transplanting.

crop_care.notes: Weeding, earthing up, split top dressings, and intensive insect pest sprays.

harvest.notes: Continuous weekly pod pickings from 85 DAS through final harvest at 140 DAS.
